length_of.description: returns the length of a NUL-terminated string by scanning for a NUL byte

error_setter.description: printf-style function that records an error message; its format arguments must be valid C strings

logger.description: printf-style function that logs a message; its format arguments must be valid C strings

untrusted_size.description: returns the explicit length of a length-delimited buffer; the buffer is not guaranteed to be NUL-terminated
